prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration. Imposing undeniable main subject, high-contrast low-key dark walnut/antique gold palette, textured brushwork and physically tactile surfaces, legible silhouette at 200 pixels. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, pseudo-script, logo, watermark, signature, border or frame; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glowing aura, neon lines, energy ribbons, floating runes, or unsupported anatomy.
ANATOMY: ONE integrated ARDHANARISVARA, Shiva-Parvati joined and EQUALLY divided vertically. Anatomical RIGHT is male Shiva = VIEWER LEFT. Anatomical LEFT is female Parvati = VIEWER RIGHT. ONE head with one centered nose and mouth, ONE eye on each side; right male face/body contour on viewer-left clearly angular and robust, left female on viewer-right clearly soft and graceful. TWO arms and TWO legs as conservative editorial human-form anatomy, no extra limbs or unsupported iconographic attributes. Fully opaque dark antique-gold robe on male viewer-left and crimson-gold sari on female viewer-right, matching centerline down the whole figure. No bare torso, no third eye, no trident, no crescent or snakes. [ardhanarisvara-c01/c02/c04/c07] MOMENT: Step forcefully forward down one large sacred stone step, hips and robe flow diagonally but upper torso and face stay FRONTAL so viewer can compare equal halves; both hands lifted apart in open balancing gestures, gaze downward commanding and compassionate. POWER: no physical magic effect, unity of universe's masculine/feminine principles expressed by body division and balanced movement. [ardhanarisvara-c03] SCALE & CAMERA: full-body worm-eye devotional composition, entire god from head through two feet fills upper 85 percent square, tiny abstract court steps at bottom provide editorial hierarchical sacred scale, no literal giant body assertion, no people necessary. LIGHT & WEATHER: one natural dawn shaft from distant doorway, dark walnut sacred space with hard gold rim along moving opaque cloth, no halo. SURFACE: thick woven robes, worn stone step, textured skin. SETTING: editorial symbolic sacred architecture for united deity, not claimed historical site. MOOD: sublime imposing respect for living Hindu tradition, never two separate people, not a static costume fashion image.

visual_requirements.description: One unified equally vertically divided form: anatomical right half male Shiva (viewer-left), anatomical left half female Parvati (viewer-right), not two adjacent people or two heads.
No sourced physical power manifestation; sacred grandeur through unity, active stance and editorial devotional scale only.
Editorial abstract sacred architecture, no researched specific location asserted; the united deity dominates.

selection_reason: Proposed selected: complete equal body split, correct left/right mapping and active advancing step clearer than cropped portrait.

visual_review.notes: Native viewed: whole single united deity steps forward down sacred stairs, robe moving diagonally. Anatomical right male on viewer-left, left female on viewer-right, equal vertical face/body split with one central nose/mouth. One head/two eyes/two arms/two open hands/two feet. Masculine half dark-gold robe and feminine half crimson sari fully opaque. Low viewpoint and sacred scale convey grandeur without invented magic emission; no text, watermark, gore or film design.
limitations: Two arms/two legs is conservative editorial anatomy; accepted claims specify split and side gender but not limb count.
Hair ornaments, costume/jewelry, relief carvings and sacred court architecture editorial, not asserted source iconography.
Hierarchical perspective is editorial sacred composition, not a claim of literal gigantic body.
